shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline --decorate && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && sed -n '1,130p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,180p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,120p' && rg -n 'reanchor|spec:names|prettier' package.json scripts .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'changelog|spec:names' package.json scripts | head -40 && npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && npm run spec:names -- --fix"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "bash scripts/check-changelog.sh origin/main && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,120p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n 'specs/.+#|@spec|spec:' src/**/*.test.ts | head -40"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,120p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n 'specs/.+#|@spec|spec:' src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -60"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "docs: record non-Error hook behavior" && bash scripts/check-changelog.sh origin/main && git status --short --branch'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
